# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->

## Findings
- Task (TASK.md, sphinx #8459): `autodoc_type_aliases` ignored when `autodoc_typehints='description'`.
  Root cause: `record_typehints()` in `sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py` called
  `inspect.signature(obj)` WITHOUT `type_aliases`, so annotations recorded for the
  description stage were raw (`Dict[str, Any]`), not alias-resolved.
  Fix (1 line, in working tree, uncommitted): pass
  `type_aliases=app.config.autodoc_type_aliases` — matches what every other
  call site in `sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py` already does.
- Verified by building the issue repro in C:/Windows/Temp/repro8459 (module renamed types→mymods:
  `types` collides with the stdlib module in autodoc imports): description mode now
  shows `**data** (*JSONObject*)` / `Return type: JSONObject`; signature mode shows
  `sphinx_doc(data: JSONObject) -> JSONObject`. Both match the issue's expected output.
- tests/test_ext_autodoc_configs.py: `test_autodoc_type_aliases` +
  `test_autodoc_typehints_description` PASS with the fix. Full-file and
  tests/test_ext_autodoc.py pass/fail sets are IDENTICAL with and without the fix
  (stash-compared): pre-existing failures are Python 3.12 stringification artifacts
  (`Optional[Any]`→`Any`, `\x1b` ANSI in captured output), not regressions.

## Decisions
- Did NOT change `sphinx/util/typing.py` (`get_type_hints(obj, None, localns)` →
  `globalns`): explored it first, but the minimal correct fix is the typehints.py
  one-liner; typing.py was reverted to keep the diff minimal.

## Leads / environment (future sessions read this first)
- The campaign venv (…/stack/campaign/.venv) has sphinxcontrib applehelp/devhelp
  2.0.0 + htmlhelp 2.1.0, which call `app.require_sphinx('5.0')`; this checkout is
  Sphinx 3.4.0 → EVERY app-building test errors at setup ("needs at least Sphinx v5.0").
  Pre-existing, unrelated to any source fix.
- Workaround used: `PYTHONPATH=C:/Windows/Temp/sph8459_compat` (era-compatible sphinxcontrib
  1.0.x namespace package copied from C:/Windows/Temp/sph9658_venv; shadows the 2.x ones).
  Run tests as:
  `PYTHONPATH=C:/Windows/Temp/sph8459_compat .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/...`
  (run from the project root so `sphinx` resolves to the checkout).
- pypi.org is network-blocked; pip install won't work. Reuse on-disk wheels/venvs.
